title.subtitle: Reads typically outnumber mutations by orders of magnitude — the colour scale is logarithmic so mutations stay visible.

url.query: FROM logs-serverless.audit.otel-elastic_cloud | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" | EVAL verb = CASE(attributes.event.action LIKE "*_execution_cancel", "cancel", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run_soon", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_test", "test", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_enable", "enable", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_disable", "disable", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_put_*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_open_*", "open", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_start_*", "start", attributes.event.action LIKE "*point_in_time", "pit", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_create*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_update*", "update", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_delete", "delete", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_find", "find", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_get", "get", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_resolve", "resolve", "other") | GROK body.text """\[(?:id|workflowId)=%{DATA:g_id}(?:,|\])""" | EVAL obj_id = COALESCE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.id, g_id) | EVAL obj_type = CASE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type, attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_job", "ml-job", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_datafeed", "ml-datafeed", attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_execution_*", "workflow-execution", attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_*", "workflow", attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_agent_*", "agent-builder-agent", attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_tool_*", "agent-builder-tool", attributes.event.action LIKE "product_documentation_*", "product-documentation", attributes.event.action == "secret_create", "secret", attributes.event.action IS NULL, "unclassified", REPLACE(attributes.event.action, "_(create|update|delete|enable|disable|run|run_soon|test|cancel)$", "")) | WHERE obj_id IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*), objects = COUNT_DISTINCT(obj_id) BY so_type = obj_type, verb | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 80
